grid.description: Demo-only 0.05° grid used to count active cells.

reference_period.description: Same calendar month across all fixture years, per region and per sensor.

hotspot_count.label: Detections
hotspot_count.description: Hot pixels flagged by the sensor in the month. A hot pixel is not an independent fire.

active_cells.label: Active grid cells
active_cells.description: Grid cells with at least one detection.

percentile_vs_reference.label: Percentile vs reference
percentile_vs_reference.description: Rank of the month against the same calendar month in the reference period, computed separately for each sensor.

frp_sum_mw.label: Summed fire radiative power
frp_sum_mw.description: Sum of FRP over the month's detections.

limitations: Raw MODIS and VIIRS counts are not directly comparable: resolution, sensitivity, overpass time and confidence definitions all differ.
A hotspot is a hot pixel. It is not an independent fire.
A thermal anomaly does not indicate cause or intent. No detection does not mean no fire.
